name: Sparse Voxel Octree with Bricks
definition: A hierarchical scene representation where the root node represents the entire scene, and children represent an eighth of the parent's volume. It stores filtered scene information (energy intensity, direction, occlusion, and Normal Distribution Functions - NDFs) with increasing precision by descending the hierarchy.
summary: Sparse Voxel Octree with Bricks is a hierarchical scene representation storing filtered lighting in 3x3x3 voxel volumes to enable smooth, geometry-independent indirect illumination at real-time frame rates.
